title: Hummingbird PVP Resource Pack
description: A PVP Pack that turns things like totems and elytras into hummingbird-related textures.
body: A texture pack changing some items used in PVP. Examples include the elytra looking like hummingbird wings, crystals having a cool new look, and even apples and golden apples looking like bugs for you to munch down. Prepare for an immersive experience with the Hummingbird PVP Resource Pack.
